Resolves #19544

🌿 A header reorder can no longer be answered by a strip that is, for one pass, the active tab alone: a rail that has no box yet is no rail, and the plugin now says so where it measures.

The overflow plugin's post-drag pass took the first action rect's x as the rail's start. When the drag's focus had just brought the contextual actions back, that rect was all zeros (the insert had not landed), `coordinateExtent` read 0 and every unprotected tab was withheld until the next pass: ~65 ms of the strip showing only the active tab and the "…" control, with the motion signal idle. `actionStart` now comes from the first action rect with a main-axis size; with none laid out, the size path decides. One line of logic in `Overflow#project`, one red-first unit arm.

Evidence: L2 (unit arm, red with dev's source, green at the head) + L3 (headless component runs on `examples/dashboard/dock`: no tab-button removal after the reorder, the click arm 10/10) → L3 required for AC-3 / AC-4. Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs run in CI.
